question: Who was named the Men’s Player of the Year at the All India Football Federation Awards 2025 in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Subhasish Bose**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Subhasish Bose**, the veteran defender and captain of **Mohun Bagan Super Giant**, was named the **AIFF Men’s Player of the Year** for the **2024-25** season. The announcement was made during the **All India Football Federation (AIFF)** annual awards ceremony held in **May 2025**.
 
• He was recognized for his stellar defensive performances and his leadership in guiding **Mohun Bagan Super Giant** to significant success in domestic competitions, including the **Indian Super League (ISL)**.
 
• In the women's category, the prestigious **AIFF Women’s Player of the Year** award was conferred upon **Indumathi Kathiresan** for her exceptional display of skill and consistency in the national team midfield.
 
• The **Men’s Coach of the Year** award was won by **Khalid Jamil**, who has been instrumental in the progress of **Jamshedpur FC**. He remains one of the most prominent Indian coaches in the top flight of Indian football.
 
• The awards are based on performances during the **2024-25** footballing calendar, taking into account contributions to both club and the **Indian National Team**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Emerging Players:**
 
 
• **Brison Fernandes**, who plays for **FC Goa**, was named the **AIFF Men’s Emerging Player of the Year** for his breakthrough season in the midfield.
 
• The **Women’s Emerging Player of the Year** award was given to **Neha**, acknowledging her rising potential in the **Indian Women's League (IWL)**.
 
 
 
• **Goalkeeping Excellence:**
 
 
• **Vishal Kaith**, the goalkeeper for **Mohun Bagan Super Giant**, was honored with the **Best Goalkeeper** award for his remarkable number of clean sheets and vital saves throughout the season.
 
 
 
• **Coaching Awards:**
 
 
• While **Khalid Jamil** took the men's coaching honors, **Sukla Dutta** was recognized as the **Women’s Coach of the Year** for her tactical contributions to women's football development in the country.
 
 
 
• **About AIFF:**
 
 
• The **All India Football Federation (AIFF)** is the governing body for football in India. It was founded in **1937** and is headquartered in **Dwarka, New Delhi**.
 
• The federation manages the **Indian National Team**, the **Indian Super League (ISL)**, the **I-League**, and the **Indian Women's League**. It became affiliated with **FIFA** in **1948**.
 
• The **AIFF Awards** serve as the highest official recognition for football players and officials in **India**, celebrating excellence across various tiers of the sport.
